record.question: The common carotid artery bifurcates into the internal and external carotid arteries at the level of which cervical vertebra?
record.explanation: Answer B: C4. The common carotid bifurcation is typically near the upper border of the thyroid cartilage at about the C4 vertebral level. Source/context note: Bifurcation level varies anatomically; C3–C5 range may occur. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK470353/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
